attempted_claim: Let K be a number field and E/K an elliptic curve with Gal(K(E[2])/K) ≅ S3. For quadratic characters χ ordered by the norm of the conductor of E^χ, does the natural density of twists with each prescribed 2-Selmer rank r ≥ 0 exist, and do there exist a constant δ_cond(E/K) ∈ [−1/2,1/2] and c_r = (∏_{j≥1}(1+2^(−j))^(−1))(∏_{j=1}^r 2/(2^j−1)) such that the density is (1/2−δ_cond(E/K))c_r for even r and (1/2+δ_cond(E/K))c_r for odd r?
decisive_failure: Per-twist Euler/Kolyvagin methods cover only low-rank twists and published 2-Selmer distribution theorems require reducible mod-2 image, so the S3 conductor-ordered all-r density claim needs new irreducible-case machinery beyond a bounded session; routine coherence checks performed do not substitute for that missing theorem.
